carpet.rule.debugLog.name: debugLog
carpet.rule.debugLog.desc: Outputs verbose lifecycle logs of this mod, for debugging.
carpet.rule.debugLog.extra.0: Only changes log verbosity; no gameplay effect.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSpawnPreload.name: fakePlayerSpawnPreload
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSpawnPreload.desc: When /player <name> spawn is used, preload the player's profile (UUID + skin) asynchronously first, then spawn - so spawning does not stall the server.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSpawnPreload.extra: Each name is preloaded once; if resolution fails the spawn still happens with the offline fallback.
Disable to restore Carpet's original spawn flow.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerRejoinKeepRiding.d: Restores the vehicle a fake player was riding when it comes back online: works for Carpet TIS Addition's /player <name> rejoin and for GugleCarpetAddition's fakePlayerResident (bots restored after a server restart).
carpet.rule.fakePlayerRejoinKeepRiding.e: Reads the vehicle UUID from RootVehicle in playerdata, waits for its chunk, then puts the fake player back on it. It only re-mounts - never spawns a vehicle, so no duplicate carts.
The vehicle must be within 8 blocks (waits up to 15 seconds), so /player <name> spawn elsewhere never drags the bot back to an old vehicle.
carpet.rule.commandBatchPlayerAction.des: Enables batch fake player actions: every /player action is mounted under Carpet Org Addition's batch command, next to its built-in spawn/kill/drop, with full tab completion. Values: false / true / ops / 0-4, same meaning as commandPlayer.
carpet.rule.commandBatchPlayerAction.ext: Usage: /playerManager batch <prefix> <start> <end> <action>, e.g. batch bot 1 45 use continuous, or batch bot 1 45 stop.
Targets follow Carpet Org's convention: batch bot 1 45 means bot_1..bot_45; all or * targets every fake player. Actions and arguments match /player exactly.
carpet.rule.commandPlayerLoadRange.name: commandPlayerLoadRange
carpet.rule.commandPlayerLoadRange.desc: Enables the load range command: /player <bot> load [radius|default], enlarging a single fake player's chunk loading range. Enlarge only - it can never go below the server view distance. Values: false / true / ops / 0-4, same meaning as commandPlayer.
carpet.rule.commandPlayerLoadRange.extra: For example /player bot1 load 8; /player bot1 load default restores the server view distance behaviour.
Bots without a setting load chunks exactly like vanilla. A radius not larger than the server view distance has no extra effect, because vanilla tickets cannot be cancelled.
carpet.rule.minecartChunkLoader.name: minecartChunkLoader
carpet.rule.minecartChunkLoader.desc: Enables the minecart chunk loader: a matching minecart standing on a matching rail gets a loading ticket every 5 seconds, keeping the surrounding chunks loaded and ticking.
carpet.rule.minecartChunkLoader.extra.0: Configure minecartLoaderTypes (cart types), minecartLoaderRails (rail types) and minecartLoaderRange (radius).
carpet.rule.minecartChunkLoader.extra.1: Tickets expire after 15 seconds (refreshed every 5 seconds on purpose, two cycles of slack): once the cart leaves the rail or disappears, chunks unload within 15 seconds - nothing persists.
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderTypes.name: minecartLoaderTypes
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderTypes.desc: Comma separated minecart types that trigger loading, e.g. minecart,chest_minecart,hopper_minecart. The minecraft: prefix is optional.
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderRails.name: minecartLoaderRails
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderRails.desc: Comma separated rail blocks that trigger loading, e.g. rail,powered_rail,detector_rail,activator_rail.
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderRange.name: minecartLoaderRange
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderRange.desc: Chunk radius kept loaded around the cart, 1-32, default 2.
carpet.rule.minecartLoaderRange.extra.0: Cost grows with the square of the radius - keep it small.
carpet.rule.minecartScanInterval.name: minecartScanInterval
carpet.rule.minecartScanInterval.desc: Scan interval (ticks), default 100 (5 seconds). Rail checks, ticket renewal and cart discovery all happen in this one pass; only loaded chunks are scanned.
carpet.rule.minecartScanInterval.extra.0: Smaller = faster detection (a cart may only sit on the rail for 2 ticks per machine cycle) but an entity sweep and ticket grants every pass; larger = cheaper but may miss.
carpet.rule.minecartScanInterval.extra.1: When a cart is in the same chunk on two consecutive grants it switches to the 30-second idle ticket, so parked machines do not need constant renewal.
carpet.rule.noAmethystBudInWater.name: noAmethystBudInWater
carpet.rule.noAmethystBudInWater.desc: Budding amethyst never grows amethyst buds on a face whose neighbouring block is water.
carpet.rule.noAmethystBudInWater.extra.0: Only affects newly grown buds; existing buds and clusters are untouched.
